title: Telescope 51 archive-addressing corollary

based_on.title: The Line Game | Surprise Is Not Meaning

exact_statement: Holding every card outside the 18-card equal-weight class fixed, and holding fixed the set of positions occupied by that class, all 18! internal permutations preserve the complete positionwise weight profile. Therefore every declared one-based index in the verified archive admits an injective code inside this fiber.
decoding_requirements: a declared ordering and factorial unranking rule for the 18-card class
the external archive that maps an index to an ordinate
not_claimed: the cards compute a Riemann zeta zero
the encoding extends the verified archive height
the archive address determines an uncomputed decimal tail
the corollary proves the Riemann Hypothesis
